claim.claim-text: 2. A core network node (9) for mobility management comprising:

means (71) for sending, to a base station (5b), Non-Access Stratum, NAS, signalling for a communication device (3); and means (71) for receiving, from the base station (5b), if a Radio Access Network, RAN,-based paging, to the communication device (3) for the NAS signalling fails, a UE Context Release Request message in a release procedure that is to move connection management, CM, state of the communication device (3) in the core network node (9) for mobility management to CM-IDLE, without invoking releasing a connection from another node in the core network.

sending (S501a, S601a), to a base station (5b), Non-Access Stratum, NAS, signalling for a communication device (3); and receiving (S505, S605) from the base station (5b), if a Radio Access Network, RAN,-based paging to the communication device (3) fails, a UE Context Release Request message in a release procedure that is to move connection management, CM, state of the communication device (3) in the core network node (9) for mobility management to CM-IDLE, without invoking releasing a connection from another node in the core network.
